Sam (AE): Heads-up: Spectral wants a migration POC from CompetitorX. Primary asks: minimal client changes, billing delta report, security appendix answers, and a fallback plan that doesn't leak data. Can we scope and owners?
Ivy (SE): We should aim for a facade exposing /v1/generate with identical streaming frames and webhook callback behavior. Need to know which headers their client relies on.
Diego (Solutions): I'll request their client docs and sample payloads. For token billing parity, propose we run a token-diff over 500 representative requests and produce per-request deltas + projected monthly delta.
Nora (Security): Their questionnaire focuses on encryption (KMS + CMK), data residency (EU), log retention, and whether any PII is sent to third parties on fallback. They also want proof of SOC2 scope.
Tom (Infra): For the POC latency target: p99 < 250ms for short completions. Recommend a dedicated eu-west pool for the test. I can provision trial nodes once scope is locked.
Ivy (SE): Streaming detail: CompetitorX emits frames like {event: 'chunk', seq, payload} and finalizes with {event: 'done'}. Our runtime sends tokenized chunks. We'll add a framing shim that rewraps chunks into the client's expected events. Also map CompetitorX's tool result -> our function_call output and preserve tool ids.
Diego (Solutions): I'll prepare a dockerized eval harness (200 prompts) that measures exact-match, BLEU-lite, and embedding cosine similarity. Target: >80% semantic similarity for core flows.
Sam (AE): Legal flagged fallback behavior. They want an option to disable automatic fallback to CompetitorX during POC and a guarantee that full request bodies won't be forwarded without explicit consent.
Nora (Security): We'll provide a config toggle for fallback and an attestation text: "No raw prompt or response bodies are forwarded to third parties during automatic fallback; routing metadata only." Will deliver appendix answers by Friday.
Diego (Solutions): Token-diff command I'll run: python tools/token_diff.py --a competitorx-v1 --b redwood-base --i spectral_samples.jsonl --o spectral_deltas.csv. Will attach README explaining tokenization edge cases.
Tom (Infra): Canary plan: 1) facade in staging, 2) dedicated pool + smoke tests, 3) 2% production traffic with rollback triggers for latency, error rate, or semantic regression. I'll add tracing tags and a QA dashboard.
ops-bot: infra: staging-spectral provisioned, 2 GPUs reserved, logs streaming enabled.
Ivy (SE): I'll prototype the streaming frame adapter and the tool->function mapping today.
Diego (Solutions): I'll start token-diff and the eval harness runs now; will publish results in POC repo.
Nora (Security): Questionnaire answers and attestation by Fri EOD.
Sam (AE): Spectral asked for a demo in 5 business days. Is that realistic?
Tom (Infra): Yes if scope limited to /v1/generate and they provide sample corpus today.
Sam (AE): I'll request the corpus and schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow morning. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
